# Humanitix

Humanitix is a not-for-profit ticketing platform that donates 100% of its profits to charity.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/humanitix/.

## Actions

- **Get Event** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific event.
- **Get Events**: Retrieve a paginated list of events from your humanitix account.
- **Get Tags**: Get all tags associated with your humanitix account.
